title: A smart playlist's rule (R8.9): the JSON after #MUSIKATA-RULE: in its playlist file, on one line

rating.description: Rating at least this many stars

genre.description: Genre is this one, case aside

artist.description: Artist (the song's or its album's) is this one, case aside

years.description: Year between these two, both included; null leaves that end open

added.description: Added in the last this many days

plays.description: Played at least this many times, every computer's plays added up

limit.description: The first this many songs in its order; none: every song
